questionEn: Please mark the exact description for “heating is carried out on a gas burner”?
questionUz: "Isitish gaz gorelkasida amalga oshiriladi" uchun aniq tavsifni belgilang?
choicesEn: At the top of the flame where the temperature is higher
In the middle of the flame
At the very bottom of the tap
